title: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift in the UK
one_line: PEAD exists in UK stocks under three surprise measures (forecast-based, return-based, revision-based) and is not explained by size, book-to-market or risk.

findings.statement: Significant drift for all three surprise measures.

reported_results.headline: PEAD exists in UK stocks under three surprise measures (forecast-based, return-based, revision-based) and is not explained by size, book-to-market or risk.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
